about: Yakov Mushiyev & Associates works from Cross Island Plaza in Rosedale and publishes its people with their jobs beside them: Yakov Mushiyev and Gabriel Borokhov as attorneys, Eduard Tamma as a trial attorney, and its paralegals named as paralegals.

590 reviews at 5.0. It is one of the few firms in this market that publishes a fee statement as well as a contingency promise, and it offers hospital visits and pages in Spanish. Its largest contentful paint on mobile is 11.5 seconds, among the slowest here.
